intro.text: W is reached by your left ring finger, above S. O is for your right ring finger, above L.
intro.tip: Ring fingers are less strong, so go slowly and let accuracy come first.

steps.title: Meet W and O
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: sws lol sws lol www ooo low who wow slow toe
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Real words
steps.instructions: Every word uses only keys you have learnt.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: we sit at the shore; who would like a slow walk; the wise owl looks out of a tower; we work hard all day;
our dog follows us to the hollow; would you like water; the world is wide; two owls look so wise;
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
